inputs.value:
LIP-SYNC PERFORMANCE VIDEO.

IDENTITY: The performer is the character in the character-sheet reference image. That sheet is the single source of truth for identity - same face, same facial structure, same hairstyle, same proportions from every angle it shows. Do not restyle, do not change age, ethnicity, hair or wardrobe. Keep one single subject on screen; no duplicated or background copies of the character.

LIP SYNC: The character sings the reference audio track. Mouth shape, jaw opening and tongue position must match the phonemes of that audio frame by frame. Full lip closure on m / b / p, teeth-to-lip contact on f / v, wide open vowels on sustained notes, and a still, closed or relaxed mouth during instrumental gaps and rests. Never mouth words that are not in the audio.

PERFORMANCE: Breathing, head bobs, shoulder motion, eyebrow lifts and micro-expressions follow the rhythm, dynamics and emotion of the vocal. Natural blinks. Consistent teeth and inner mouth. Body motion is alive but never louder than the singing.

WORLD: Location, time of day, color grading, lighting direction and intensity stay coherent with the key-visual reference image throughout the shot.

QUALITY: Photoreal continuity, stable identity, no face morphing, no identity drift, no warped hands, no extra limbs, no on-screen text, no lyrics captions, no subtitles, no watermark, no split screen.
